snippet.description:
How do you build your dream career when your dream job doesn’t call back?

Dan Toomey was rejected by the job he'd always wanted for four straight years. It was the luckiest thing that ever happened for his career. 

Now, he’s the host of Good Work, where he makes funny videos about news in business, tech and finance that are watched by millions. 

In this episode: how do you build your dream job out of a job you never expected? Plus: why creating in public might get you hired, why Dan stopped looking at the numbers, and the case for taking up fly fishing in your 20s (and beyond).
